author: Unsigned, found in a Riverwood cellar
pages:
#Dragonslayers

The Blades began as hunters of dragons, sworn to a Dragonborn emperor out of Akavir's shadow. For a thousand years they guarded the Ruby Throne, and for a thousand years the dragons stayed gone.

Guardians without the thing they guard grow strange. The Blades became spies, then bodyguards, then rumors.

#The Purge

When the Empire signed its treaty with the Thalmor, the Blades were the price. Agents in every province were found and killed in a single season. The elves had lists. Someone had given them lists.

Those who survived learned to be innkeepers, farmers, drunks. They learned to forget their own names.

#What Remains

I know of perhaps three of us left in Skyrim. One keeps the old archives in his head, and hides in a sewer because the Thalmor want that head. One keeps an inn, and a sword under the floorboards.

If the dragons ever come back, we will be ready. That is what we tell ourselves. We are not ready. We are old, and there are very few of us. But we will go anyway.
